=== all keywords
class C1
abstract class C2
abstract C3
interface C4
enum C5
annotation C6
entity C7
circle C8
diamond C9
protocol C10
struct C11
exception C12
metaclass C13
stereotype C14
dataclass C15
record C16
map C17
static class C18
abstract   class C19
=== quoted and as
class "Long Name" as LN
class LN2 as "Other Name"
class "Quoted"
class "Gen<T>" as G1
class G2 as "Gen<K,V>"
class "with space" as W {
}
=== generics
class Box<T>
class Pair<K, V>
class Nested<Map<String, List<Integer>>>
class Sp <T extends Number>
class Deep<A<B<C<D<E>>>>>
=== stereotypes and spots
class A <<service>>
class B << (S,#FF7700) Singleton >>
class C <<(X,red)>>
class D <<a>> <<b>>
class E <<<<style1>>>>
class F << (I,orchid) >>
interface G <<(C,#ADD1B2) control>>
=== stereotype bad color
class A << (S,#notacolor) Singleton >>
=== colors and line colors
class A #red
class B #back:yellow;line:blue
class C ##red
class D ##[dashed]blue
class E #pink ##[bold]green
class F ##[dotted]
class G #lightblue/white
=== bad colors
class A #notacolorx
=== urls
class A [[http://example.com]]
class B [[http://example.com{tooltip}]]
class C [[http://example.com{tooltip} label]]
class D [[{only tooltip}]]
=== visibility on classes
-class A
#class B
~class C
+class D
- class E
=== extends implements
class A extends B
class C implements D
class E extends F implements G, H
interface I extends J
class K extends "Long Name"
class L extends M {
}
interface N extends O {
  method()
}
class P implements Q,R,S
=== tags
class A $tag1
class B $tag1 $tag2
class C <<st>> $tag3
class D $t1 <<st>> $t2
=== redefinition
class A
interface A
enum A
class B
B : field
class B {
  other
}
abstract class B
=== redefinition errors
note "x" as N
class N
=== redefinition multiline error
note "x" as N
class N {
}
=== empty braces
class A {}
class B { }
interface C {   }
=== static class
static class A
static   class B {
  x
}
=== namespaced classes
class a.b.C
class a.b.D
class x.Y
class .Root
=== bad names
class a..b
=== bad name trailing
class a.b.
=== bad hierarchy
class A
class A.B
=== spaces
class    A
  class B  
class	C
